notes.title: ALLBLACK original writer has passed away
notes.content:
It is with the heavy heart that I have to announce that ALLBLACK original writer/creator, fsc, has passed away last month (12/05/2023) due to an illness. It was very sudden and unexpected outcome, and until this day I personally can't still accept the truth. Regardless, I have a responsibility to deliver this news, as bitter as it could be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35583068/0c3e2effe9627749a6d7d1f0293c995e3476c652.jpg[/img]

Now, regarding the continuation of ALLBLACK. ALLBLACK itself is planned to have around 24 chapters. Since Phase 1 is only covers 6 chapters so I expect there will be until Phase 4. Unfortunately I only got the script until Phase 2 (until chapter 12 or so). Since I have no access to his files, I don't think I can continue adapting ALLBLACK anymore. I asked one of my friend to at least make a conclusive ending based on the story so far, but I can't make any promises yet. I would be delighted to make another adaptation if the story is done though.

Regardless, thank you for your continued support. May he rest in peace and his legacy lives in people's heart.

notes.content:

notes.title: ALLBLACK Phase 1 Full Release!
notes.content:
Finally after 2 years of development, ALLBLACK Phase 1 has been released!

This full release contains:

[olist]
[*] 60.000 words, around 4-6 hours reading
[*] 8 achievements
[*] Bonus contents such as original illustration from light novel
[*] 2 languages available (can switch halfway): English and Russian
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35583068/5bd9ec126ef0d91cd614f26a9ea362879719da98.jpg[/img]

Would love to hear your feedback!
If the reception is good enough I will continue to release the next Phase ːsteamhappyː and more localization in the future!

notes.title: Release Known Issues
notes.content:
I've released the full product today but for some reason only the demo appeared on Steam store page. I've checked the app package and make sure it contains the depot for full release, but its status is disabled and nothing I could do to enable it.
Please wait for 2-3 working days until the Steam Staff resolved this issues.
I'm sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: One Week to Full Release!
notes.content:
Are you excited for ALLBLACK Phase 1 full release?
We have good news for you! The game will be released on [b]Nov 20[/b] approximately on 6.00 PM PST, it means one week ahead for now! ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35583068/3506b5cbc6ccbfb3d80729194ed23450337206ed.jpg[/img]

In case why you wondering why I set the release date as Nov 20...well the date just seems "rhymes", and it's coincides with special occasions in my life. It's more a personal choice than technical aspect.
The full release will include 6 chapters in English and Russian (worth 4-6 hours of reading), achievements as you progressed the story, and some bonus contents. It will be completely free of charges!

Hopefully it's worth the wait! Add to your wishlist if you haven't now! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Autumn Game Festival Announcement
notes.content:
We will participate on Autumn 2020 Game Festival!

It's been a year since we uploaded the demo in this site. A lot has happened in our world, the developer itself is no exception, but finally the development starts kicking again! Thank you so much for your feedback on the first release, it's really an honor for us as a beginner. 

We are positive Q4 2020 (hopefully around November/December) is a realistic target to launch this visual novel. In addition to the previous planned features, we will try our best to include Russian and Japanese translation, albeit only partial. And depends on the reception, we will continue to produce the continuation of ALLBLACK : Phase 2 :D

We also plan to open Q&A developer session on discord soon (in schedule with Autumn Game Festival), please looking forward to it :)

notes.title: ALLBLACK Phase 1 Demo is Released!
notes.content:
We are proudly present ALLBLACK Phase 1 Demo. This demo covers Chapter 1-3 of the originally planned 6-chapters visual novel. Because of some technical misunderstanding yesterday, I rollback the "release" status and present the demo instead. The final product is scheduled to release on Q1 2020 (around February, although it might be faster depending on our circumstances). 

Please note that this demo does not reflect the final product. Some changes regarding user interface and features might be expected, although the main story stays the same.

If you're more comfortable to play on mobile device, [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.allblack.program]we also have Android version available in Google Play[/url]. You can play it for free also, and it'll be updated per chapter basis.

Feedback are greatly appreciated, and hopefully you enjoy this visual novel :)
Please consider to donate some cash if you want to support our development on [url=paypal.me/tiyanovlita]my Paypal[/url] ;)

We'll keep updating on regular basis.

Best regards
NSAID Team
